queries.rationale: Collect empirical reports and analyses of LLM-generated incorrect or unsafe network configs (phenomenon identification).
source_preferences: vendor whitepapers (Cisco, Juniper) for concrete config semantics

queries.query: failure modes of LLM agents in operations "agentic" "network operations" failure modes
queries.rationale: Survey documented failure modes when LLMs/agentic systems perform operational tasks (phenomenon + mechanism).

queries.query: prompting strategies chain-of-thought tool-use effect on correctness "network configuration" prompting "chain of thought"
queries.rationale: Understand how prompting/chain-of-thought and tool-integration influence model reasoning that produces configs (mechanisms).

queries.query: decoding parameters temperature top-k top-p impact correctness "configuration generation"
queries.rationale: Investigate how sampling/decoding settings affect reliability and reproducibility of generated configs (mechanisms).
Locate prior generate–validate–repair architectures applied to NetOps or closely related domains (mitigations/methods).

queries.rationale: Find established deterministic/network-verification tools (Batfish, NetKAT, Veriflow) and literature on using them to validate generated configs (mitigation/benchmarking tools).

queries.query: constrained generation DSL structured output templates "network config" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Explore structured-output approaches and domain-specific languages that reduce generation errors (mitigation methods).

queries.rationale: Inventory existing benchmarks/datasets used to evaluate LLMs / AIOps in networking and assess their scope and limitations (benchmark validity).
source_preferences: official benchmark project pages and GitHub

queries.query: evaluation metrics for network configuration correctness reachability compliance isolation "evaluation metrics"
queries.rationale: Gather literature on operationally meaningful metrics (reachability, isolation, policy compliance, rollback safety) to judge benchmark validity and metric selection.

queries.rationale: Identify platforms for executing and validating LLM-generated configs under realistic topologies (methods for empirical evaluation).

queries.rationale: Locate formal/symbolic methods for checking properties of configurations and policies (mechanisms and mitigation by formal methods).
Survey works on translating high-level intent to concrete configs and on automated repair techniques (neighbouring methods and mitigations).

queries.query: AIOps automated network management closed-loop "autonomous network" "AIOps"
queries.rationale: Map adjacent literature in automated network management and closed-loop control to situate NetOps-LLM work (neighbouring work).

queries.query: security risks of automated configuration generation supply chain misconfiguration "critical infrastructure" LLM
queries.rationale: Collect work on security, adversarial, and safety risks specific to automated/LLM-driven config generation (threats and mitigations).

queries.query: datasets and corpora of network configurations "network-config dataset" "BGPStream" "RIB" GitHub
queries.rationale: Find accessible datasets, corpora, and repo examples for constructing evaluation tasks and reproducing experiments (methods/benchmarks).

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers and verified arXiv preprints
Tool and benchmark project pages, with version/tag and documentation
Public code repositories with commit history and license information
Datasets with metadata and provenance (publicly accessible)
Standards and RFCs where relevant to config semantics
Industry whitepapers only when they document concrete semantics, tools, or reproducible artifacts
exclusion_criteria: Social-media posts, tweets, or opinion pieces without primary-source links
Non-technical marketing materials lacking technical details
Proprietary datasets or closed-source tools that cannot be inspected or reproduced
Patents as sole evidence of a claimed method (may be used as leads but excluded from primary evidence)
Unverified secondary summaries that lack primary citations
date_rationale: Prioritize recent work (2019–2026) for LLM/agentic developments and benchmarks while including foundational networking and formal-verification literature from earlier years (2005–2018) where seminal (e.g., NetKAT, Batfish, Veriflow). This balances current LLM effects with enduring verification methods.
